36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
129563: The princess of the human kingdom. Kidnapped by the Demon King, she spends her days waiting for the heroes to rescue her. At least, that's how it was supposed to be...
181143: He kidnapped Syalis in her sleep, so he has hardly ever seen her awake and has never had a proper conversation with her.
181145: The Demon Cleric might seem like a gentle young man, but he is actually the demon in charge of the Demon Temple inside the Demon Castle. The Demon Cleric is usually the one called upon to use magic to resurrect anyone who happens to die in the Demon Castle.
181146: Quilladillo likes to complain a lot but is a good sport and thus has many friends. He is the type who can't say no when asked for a favor.
181147: He is a hot-blooded and straightforward brave-type man, who stood up to save the kidnapped Princess Syalis. However, the princess calls him "A-Nantoka-kun" and is not able to remember his name and existence for a long time.
181148: A cuddly teddy bear often kept as a pet. They are easily susceptible to temptation. They live in the Demon Castle in large flocks and are huge fans of Princess Syalis's brushing. Teddy Demons are low-ranking monsters of the demon variety.
185468: Great Red Siberian is a monster of the beast species and is the Demon King's faithful dog. Great Red Siberian values discipline and wants Princess Syalis to act like the hostage she is.
188215: The Castle Grunt Goblin believes himself to be the commonest of commoners. He hardly ever causes any trouble, but he often falls victim to the princess' schemes along with Quilladillo and Minotaur.
188216: Frankenzombie is a happy-go-lucky guy who laughs hysterically even when his friends are screaming due to the princess's shenanigans.
188218: Poseidon is one of the Ten Elders and the reincarnation of the Greek god. He can float and create high-pressurized blasts of water from his hands, and wearing only a loincloth earns him the nickname "Nudist" from Princess Suya.
188223: Having observed the daily lives of humans for such a long time as part of her duties, this soft, feathery demon girl longs for a human friend. She has great expectations of the Princess Syalis, the first human girl she has ever spoken with.
188225: Alazif is the spirit of the book of spells and is the embodiment of the dark fruit of human knowledge.
195000: Queen of the human kingdom and Aurora's mother.
195317: A succubus who desires popularity, and is jealous of the Princess, whom she believes is popular amongst the demons. Her fellow demons often pay her little attention, sometimes purposefully avoiding her. She sometimes is seen watching the Princess’ “quests” from the shadows.
